reason: A web search and browsing plugin providing multi-engine search, platform search, page fetching, Playwright rendering, caching, history, snapshots, and configurable extraction rules.

summaries.zh: 提供多引擎及多平台网页搜索、页面抓取与浏览器渲染，并支持缓存、历史记录、快照和自定义提取规则。
summaries.en: Provides multi-engine and multi-platform web search, page fetching and browser rendering with caching, history, snapshots, and customizable extraction rules.

capabilities: Queries multiple web search engines and platform search backends
Fetches and renders web pages through HTTP and Playwright
Stores search history, cached results, snapshots, and extraction rules locally
Can use configured API keys, cookies, and browser login state
Can detect or install external command-line and browser dependencies
